parsed.internal_thinking: Ziv is doing a great job painting me as the villain while he quietly builds a solid Wheat/Ore engine on 42 and now 25. He's trying to keep Hadar and me focused on each other. I need to secure Wheat and Ore in my next turn (SETUP_SECOND_ROUND) to remain competitive, as I currently only have Brick, Sheep, and Wood. I'll play along with the 'charming' persona but I need to make sure I don't get boxed out of the late game resources.
parsed.note_to_self: Ziv has secured a strong position on node 25 (Sheep 8, Wood 4) and 42 (Wheat/Ore). He is currently the biggest threat to my expansion but is successfully deflecting that onto me. I must get Wheat/Ore in my second placement.
